atomicity.reason: Bundles the inlet standard (IEC 63379) and the communication standard (ISO 15118-20); closely related facets of MCS support.
atomicity.suggestion: Optionally split into an inlet and a communication requirement.

comprehensibility.reason: MCS is expanded; standards are named.

feasibility.reason: Implementable with known automotive technology; contradicts nothing stated.

parent_fit.reason: MCS sessions serve fast depot charging of trucks.

variant_consistency.reason: Gated `var.charging.mcs == True`; Kconfig makes MCS depend on 800 V, which depends on bev, so it is at least as strong as the parent's bev gate.

verifiability.reason: Conformance to the two named standards is testable.
